provenance: Hand-authored synthetic English urn scenarios; original CIB development data. No sampling or generator seed.
construct: Probability reporting and evidence updating in a controlled binary task; not empirical calibration.

analysis.condition_weights: equal across predefined conditions and label variants within scenario
analysis.incomplete_policy: withhold scenario means and complete-scenario contrast; report full-set posterior-loss bounds
analysis.parser: strict JSON object with exactly probability: finite JSON number in [0,1]; no prose or coercion

scenarios.annotations: Tests symmetric supporting and opposing evidence with a balanced prior.
Tests prior sensitivity. Label swaps stay in the same base scenario.
